primept.settings.title: Prime Render Settings
NASA Deep Star Maps radiance: 0 disables, 100% keeps the default. Follows latitude and season independently of sky strength; fixed while frozen.
primept.settings.display.auto_exposure_p: Automatic exposure compensation strength: 0 disables, default 75%. Manual exposure remains an additional adjustment. Frozen offline scenes retain their exposure; linear accumulation is preserved.
primept.settings.display.hdr.tooltip: Request scRGB HDR on Windows when HDR is enabled for the current display and the Vulkan surface supports it. Unsupported surfaces keep SDR. Takes effect after surface reconfiguration.
primept.settings.display.hdr_reference_w: Reference white in nits: Auto uses the Windows SDR white level. Manual 1–10000 is capped by the active display's peak; world and UI use the same absolute luminance scale.
primept.settings.render.frame_generation: Request NVIDIA Streamline frame generation on compatible devices and surfaces. Only active realtime final output is eligible; offline and diagnostic output keep ordinary presentation. The effective mode may remain off when unavailable.
primept.settings.path_tracing.tooltip: On uses the selected realtime path tracer; off uses vanilla rendering. Retains the selected realtime renderer. Requires Vulkan and Prime enabled at startup.
primept.settings.renderer.tooltip: Select Naive PT or ReSTIR PT. The path tracing switch controls whether it is active; offline rendering is independent. Switching an active renderer completes the previous one at the next frame boundary and starts a new history.
primept.settings.offline.tooltip: Ctrl+Alt+F2 toggles. Freeze the displayed scene, camera and lighting; accumulate continuously. Esc opens the menu. Resource reload or world exit ends the snapshot; realtime resumes with a fresh capture.
primept.settings.opacity_micromap.toolti: Prefer opacity micromaps for compatible cutout surfaces. Enabled by default after device compatibility checks; unsupported surfaces retain alpha testing. Can be changed while frozen without resetting accumulation.
primept.settings.render.bounces.tooltip: 1–64 vertices, default 12, including the first hit. Reflection and transmission both count; the last vertex adds direct lighting without continuing. Fixed while frozen.
Independent samples added per pixel each frame. Realtime always uses 1; changing this preserves accumulation.
primept.settings.terrain.batches_per_fra: Maximum terrain mesh batches built per frame: 1–128, default 1. Each batch covers 4×4×4 vanilla sections. Can be adjusted while frozen: published terrain continues building, while source compilation resumes in realtime. Changing the limit preserves accumulation.
primept.settings.lighting.sun_ev_quarter: Stops relative to the default sun. Direction follows game time, latitude and season; fixed while frozen.
primept.settings.lighting.sky_ev_quarter: Exposure stops relative to the default sky; fixed while frozen.
primept.settings.display.exposure_ev_qua: Applied before the display transform. Does not reset offline accumulation.
primept.settings.display.hue_percent.too: Artistic adjustment in primeDRT; applies live without changing linear accumulated data.
primept.settings.display.saturation_perc: Artistic adjustment in primeDRT, default 20%; applies live without changing linear accumulated data. Existing saved values are preserved.
primept.settings.view.tooltip: Displays the actual realtime inputs at the selected internal render resolution; unavailable offline. Noisy color has an sRGB preview; depth is mapped by range and world normals to RGB. Guides bypass reconstruction and are enlarged to the output size.
primept.settings.ignore_global_history_r: Diagnostic, off by default. Retain compatible ReSTIR and ray reconstruction history across explicit global reset requests. Local rejection and unavailable or incompatible history resources still apply.
primept.settings.restir_pt.temporal_reus: On enables realtime ReSTIR temporal reuse; off disables it while keeping spatial reuse. Default on. Does not affect DLSS ray reconstruction history or offline accumulation.
primept.settings.native_noisy_output.too: On disables denoising and outputs native-resolution noisy color; off enables NVIDIA Streamline ray reconstruction with preset F. Requires a compatible NVIDIA RTX GPU and driver; unavailable devices use noisy output. Offline accumulation remains native resolution. The separate noisy-color diagnostic view shows the actual internal reconstruction input.
primept.settings.dlss_quality.tooltip: Default Performance renders half the output width and height (2× upscaling). Quality and Balanced use more input pixels; Ultra Performance uses fewer. DLAA keeps native resolution. Realtime reconstruction only.
primept.settings.diagnostics.depth_range: Changes only the depth preview scale. Sky is black; the actual hit depth remains unchanged.
primept.settings.astronomy.latitude_degr: Positive north, negative south. Default 30° N. Game time drives solar hour angle; fixed while frozen.
primept.settings.astronomy.solar_longitu: 0° March equinox, 90° June solstice, 180° September equinox, 270° December solstice. Independent of game day count; fixed while frozen.
primept.settings.performance_export.tool: Enable CPU/GPU diagnostics and record every frame and thread. Turn off or leave the world to disable diagnostics and export JSON in the background to artifacts/performance in the game directory. Recording adds measurement and export costs.
primept.settings.restir_pt.history_lengt: Limit the temporal reservoir confidence count, not sample age. Default 20. With duplication downweighting off, 0 removes history weight; otherwise its formula determines the local cap.
primept.settings.restir_pt.spatial_reuse: Enable spatial resampling. Default on; disabling limits reuse to the temporal stage.
primept.settings.restir_pt.spatial_itera: 0–8 spatial rounds, default 1. More rounds spread samples farther and cost more work.
primept.settings.restir_pt.spatial_neigh: 1–5 reciprocal paired neighbors per round, default 3. More candidates also increase reuse and tracing cost.
primept.settings.restir_pt.pairing_radiu: Average paired-neighbor distance: 5–50 input pixels in steps of 5, default 30. Changes the reciprocal pairing pattern.
primept.settings.restir_pt.stochastic_re: Randomly choose the temporal donor around the projected position. Default off.
primept.settings.restir_pt.duplicate_map: Reduce temporal M when the same sample occupies nearby pixels. Default on.
primept.settings.restir_pt.duplication_p: Exponent for duplicate-based M reduction, default 0.1. Smaller positive values apply stronger reduction at partial duplication.
primept.settings.restir_pt.decoupled_sha: Use weighted spatial candidate contributions for output. Default off; the next frame still reuses the selected reservoir sample.
primept.settings.restir_pt.initial_sampl: 1–16 fresh paths per input pixel and sample, default 1. More paths increase diversity and tracing cost.
primept.settings.restir_pt.distance_thre: Hybrid reconnection footprint threshold in the original control units, default 0.02. Changes reconnection classification and replay cost.
primept.settings.restir_pt.distance_sigm: Relative Gaussian width of the footprint threshold, 0–1; default 0.2.
primept.settings.restir_pt.roughness_thr: BSDF sample-PDF roughness threshold, 0–1; default 0.2. This is a path classification control, not material roughness.
primept.settings.restir_pt.roughness_sig: Relative Gaussian width of the PDF roughness threshold, 0–1; default 0.
primept.settings.restir_pt.normal_thresh: Minimum normal dot product for spatial neighbors, -1–1; default 0.5.
primept.settings.restir_pt.depth_thresho: Maximum relative camera-distance difference for spatial neighbors, 0–1; default 0.1.
primept.settings.restir_pt.debug_view.to: Show final output, local sample duplication, or sample lifetime. These diagnostics do not expire or mutate samples.
primept.settings.restir_pt.seed.tooltip: Unsigned 32-bit seed, 0–4294967295. Default 324478056. Changes the random sequence; it does not remove sample duplication.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_decorrelat: Randomly replace the final reused output with a fresh sample. Default on; changes the noisy output without changing the reused reservoir.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_mode.toolt: Choose fixed or stagnancy-dependent probability of using a fresh sample. Default stagnancy; None disables this probability term.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_factor.too: Base probability of using the fresh sample, 0–1; default 0.4. Higher values strengthen output decorrelation.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_stagnancy_: Exponent applied to smoothed sample stagnancy when choosing fresh output, 0–10; default 0.5.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_ema.toolti: Moving-average update rate for repeated samples, 0–1; default 0.2.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_firefly_st: Strength of the bright-sample test that can force fresh output, 0–1; default 0.7.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_multiply_b: Limit a fresh sample's weight relative to the reused sample's weight, 1–100; default 15. Applies when the fresh weight limit is enabled.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_bias_reduc: Bound fresh output weights to reduce bright outliers, enabled by default. This approximation does not guarantee unbiased output.
primept.settings.restir_pt.rr_firefly.to: Enable the bright-sample test that can force fresh output, enabled by default.
